newsitem.title: HUNGARY: IEB sees larger profit, activity in 1997.
newsitem.headline: IEB sees larger profit, activity in 1997.

text.p: Hungary's Inter-Europa Bank (BSE) planned to boost its pre-tax profits by some 20 percent and its balance sheet total by about 10 percent in 1997, IEB CEO Pier Franco Rubatto told a news conference on Friday.
He said IEB was likely to post a pre-tax profit of some 2.5 billion forints on a balance sheet total of approximately 100 billion forints this year.
IEB said earlier on Friday that it posted a pre-tax profit of more than two billion forints in 1996, on a balance sheet total of about 91 billion forints.
The 1996 pre-tax profit was around the planned 2.25 billion forints, while the balance sheet total was well over the planned 69.3 billion forints.
Inflation is forecast at around 17 percent for 1997.
